name: OzonFlow
postCreateCommand: curl -fsSL https://bun.sh/install | bash && sudo ln -sf /home/node/.bun/bin/bun /usr/local/bin/bun && sudo ln -sf /home/node/.bun/bin/bunx /usr/local/bin/bunx && sudo apt-get update -qq && sudo apt-get install -y libgbm1 libnss3 libatk-bridge2.0-0 libdrm2 libxkbcommon0 libxcomposite1 libxdamage1 libxfixes3 libxrandr2 libpango-1.0-0 libcairo2 libasound2 --no-install-recommends && bun install && bunx prisma generate
